text:
maggie: Heads-up — I'm moving zeta-70b-v2 into staging for a quick serving readiness pass. Need quick checks on: weights location, tokenizer diffs, declared max_context, KV cache layout (old vs interleaved), and a light memory/oom estimate. tagging folks.

aj: ping — weights are at /mnt/weights/zeta-70b-v2/{shard_00..shard_03}.pt (4 files). I ran a quick sha check, all good.

maggie: thanks. can someone sanity-check tokenizer? last time we saw UTF-8 BOM+split differences for this family.

chris: i'll run the tokenizer check. quick command: 
```
python -m scripts.tokenizer_check --model-dir /mnt/weights/zeta-70b-v2 --sample "Hello — こんにちは"
```
I expect ~7 tokens (subword) on our tokenizer. If output differs by >10% vs HF vocab, flag.

chris: result: our tokenizer -> 9 tokens, HF reference -> 7. Looks like fallback on punctuation splits. Could cause slightly higher kv cache usage but not catastrophic. Suggest adding a short token-mapping patch.

tessa: noted. i'll open a tiny mapping PR. In the meantime, recommend conservatively sizing max_context to 131072? This model claims 128k but we should leave headroom.

aj: on KV layout — current release runtime expects `kv_layout: interleaved_v2` for best memory packing. Are the model artifacts in that format?

maggie: the onboarding manifest says `kv_format: legacy_chunked`. If we serve with interleaved_v2 kernel it will convert at load time which spikes memory.

aj: conversion spike = ~1.8x peak RAM during first forward (observed on 80GB A100). That's the main OOM risk. We should either pre-convert or use a low-memory fallback.

chris: quick memory estimate run: 
```
python tools/estimate_mem.py \ 
  --weights /mnt/weights/zeta-70b-v2 \ 
  --kv-format legacy_chunked \ 
  --max-seqlen 65536 \ 
  --dtype fp16
```
Output (quick): "peak_estimate_gb": 148
```

maggie: 148GB peak = not great for staging nodes (96GB). Two options: 1) pre-convert artifacts to interleaved_v2 (we have converter script), or 2) cap max_seqlen to 32768 for staging and enable streaming fallback.

aj: I can run converter today. Command: 
```
python tools/kv_convert.py --in /mnt/weights/zeta-70b-v2 --out /mnt/weights/zeta-70b-v2-interleaved --format interleaved_v2
```
Estimate runtime ~12m, peak memory during conversion ~40GB.

chris: if you do conversion, also regenerate the manifest with `model.max_context: 131072` and `kv_format: interleaved_v2` and add `compat_tokenizer_patch: true` to note the tokenizer mapping.

maggie: sounds good. aj — can you run converter and drop converted artifacts under /mnt/weights/converted/ so we can point staging?

aj: will do. doing it on tuesday morning. tagging infra for a short drain. :eyes: @infracheck-bot can you reserve a 96GB node for conversion and one 192GB node for validation?

infracheck-bot: Reservation request received. Reserved node-astoria-01 (96GB) at 2026-03-10T09:00Z for 30m; node-helix-02 (192GB) at 2026-03-10T10:00Z for 45m.

tessa: once converted, i'll run a smoke deploy with `--max-seqlen 65536` but with `--max_batch_tokens 4096` to keep token-peaks low. If smoke passes, we'll promote.

maggie: timeline OK. follow-ups: 
- aj: run kv_convert and push converted artifacts + updated manifest 
- chris: add tokenizer mapping PR and run smoke token-diff checks 
- tessa: smoke deploy with conservative batch limits, monitor OOMs

maggie: thanks all. i'll update the onboarding checklist entry and mark "awaiting conversion" until aj confirms. :thumbsup:
